rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Kantei's account 野田内閣の発足, dated 2 September 2011, says that after the new Chief Cabinet Secretary announced the list of ministers, the Prime Minister's appointment ceremony (内閣総理大臣の親任式) and the ministers' attestation took place at the palace, after which 野田佳彦新内閣総理大臣 held a press conference at the Prime Minister's Office.

locator.section: 野田総理の動き > 平成23年9月 > 野田内閣の発足

rows.text: The same account says that the Noda cabinet was formally launched on 2 September 2011 (正式に野田内閣が発足しました).
